name: Kingdom of Han (Liu Bang)
alt: Hàn kingdom of the Eighteen Kingdoms

predecessors.name: Qin dynasty
predecessors.text: Liu Bang's kingdom at its grant in 206: 'Sichuan, Chongqing, southern Shaanxi' (Eighteen Kingdoms)

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: the Cliopatria Han shape of 203, the realm of Liu Bang and his client kings

ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu makes Liu Bang King of Han in Bashu and Hanzhong.
205: Liu Bang takes the Yong kingdom, 'central Shaanxi, and eastern Gansu'.
205: Liu Bang takes the Sai kingdom, 'northeastern Shaanxi' (same sentence as Yong).
205: Liu Bang takes the Di (Zhai) kingdom, 'northern Shaanxi' (same sentence as Yong).
205: Han Xin captures Wei Bao and Western Wei falls.
205: Han Xin's army defeats Zhao Xie's Zhao (Dai) after Chen Yu's seizure of Changshan; in November 205 'Han Xin's victory at the Battle of Jingxing'.
April 205: Liu Bang attacks Henei with Wei Bao's help.
204: the Xingyang-Chenggao standoff with Xiang Yu begins.
203: Cliopatria's 203 Han shape holds the Qi lands; no page opened dates Han Xin's conquest of Qi.
203: end of this dossier, not of the relation.
203: Liu Bang renounces the peace with Chu.
28 February 202 BC: Liu Bang's time as King of Han runs from c.

wars.name: Han conquest of the Three Qins
wars.outcome: Liu Bang took the Three Qins and Guanzhong by August or September 205.

wars.name: Han Xin's campaigns against Wei and Zhao
wars.outcome: Wei Bao was captured in October-November 205; Han Xin then defeated Chen Yu's Zhao at Jingxing (November 205).

wars.name: Chu-Han Contention
wars.outcome: A war between Liu Bang and Xiang Yu between the fall of Qin (206) and the Han dynasty (202): Pengcheng fell to a coalition under Liu Bang in September-October 205 and was retaken by Chu; the 204 standoff at Xingyang; the Hong Canal treaty renounced in 203…

certainty.note: Frontiers with Western Chu, Zhao, Yan and Qi were set by campaigns and enfeoffments, not surveys; the 203 realm includes client kingdoms.
